description: This is a Python source file implementing a FastAPI server that provides an endpoint to retrieve and transform Braintrust prompt data into a format compatible with LiteLLM. The server acts as a wrapper API, calling the external Braintrust API, processing responses, and exposing a simplified interface for clients.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] transform_braintrust_message(message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Transforms a Braintrust message dict into LiteLLM message format, including role, content, and optional name.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] transform_braintrust_response( braintrust_response: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Converts a Braintrust API response into LiteLLM prompt management format, extracting messages, model, and options.

methods.name: JSONResponse get_prompt( prompt_id: str = Query(..., description="The Braintrust prompt ID to fetch"), authorization: Optional[str] = Header( None, description="Bearer token for Braintrust API" ), )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint that fetches a Braintrust prompt by ID, authenticates via token, calls Braintrust API, and returns the transformed prompt data.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint indicating server is running.

methods.name: root()
methods.description: Root endpoint providing basic service information.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Bootstraps and runs the FastAPI server using Uvicorn on configured host and port.
